description: A discarded declaration does not reserve a local feature for its former stage (engine §13).

documents.p.md:
```jbogenbau
%stage first
%features f
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text A
%emits
%stage second
%features f
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text f? A
%redefine-stage first
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text A
%emits
```
